mechanisms.M1_LemmaQ_path_bound: opposite-wall WF anchors at FL-graph distance <= 2: the projection must equal s-1 in [2.80, 2.877084] and a path of m links moves it by at most m
mechanisms.M2_odd_cycle_parity: a same-wall pin set equalises one family across the component, forcing every FL link into the OTHER family; an odd cycle of +-1 steps cannot close
mechanisms.M3_LemmaQ_integrality: let P = the component squares pinned in one family to the SAME wall kind; every FL link inside P is forced into the OTHER family, so that family's differences inside P are INTEGERS; if P also carries a LO and a HI anchor of that family joined inside P, the difference must be an integer equal to s-1 in [2.80, 2.877084], which contains no integer -- Lemma Q verbatim.
